title: The Baby Decision: How to Make the Most Important Choice of Your Life
author: Merle Bombardieri MSW LICSW

highlights.text: The fruitful question is, “Which decision would I regret the least?” This question will give you an important clue to your own baby mystery.

So the question to ask while working on the baby decision is not whether you would resent giving up your freedom. Of course you would. The question is, how much would you resent a child? If you value and want a child, you will be able to handle the resentment.
Everyone will regret his or her decision at some moments. Regrets over what might have been are an inevitable part of life. Therefore, the question to ask is, which decision will you regret least?
